title: 🚀 Fabric Data Lead 🚀
description:
**Data, Engineering \& Architecture \| Alkemiz Pty Ltd.** 




  





**📍 Location** 




 Remote — anywhere in India.
 



**⏰ Availability** 





 🔴
 
 Only Immediate Joiners should apply.
 
 🔴
 




  





**About Alkemiz** 




 Alkemiz is a direct\-hiring IT services company focused on data engineering, analytics, and platform architecture. We build and manage modern data platforms — particularly on Microsoft Fabric — and our teams work hands\-on with Lakehouse architecture, Power BI, and cloud data engineering to deliver real business outcomes for retail\-focused clients. We operate a close\-knit offshore\-onshore delivery model, giving our engineers exposure to Australian retail data challenges within a collaborative, technically strong team that values good architecture, practical judgement, and ownership.
 



 💼
 **About the Role** 




 Alkemiz is looking for a Fabric Data Lead to serve as the technical authority for our Microsoft Fabric estate — ensuring it is well governed, fit for purpose, and aligned to business needs.
 



 The Fabric Data Lead applies strong design and architecture principles with practical judgement, leading DataOps delivery to balance agility, scalability, quality, and performance. You'll work closely with the Power BI reporting team to understand retail reporting requirements, then design data engineering solutions and semantic models that follow sound architecture patterns within operational constraints.
 



 🛠️
 **Key Responsibilities** 




*Fabric Governance* 




 📌 Ensure every Fabric asset has a clear purpose, defined lifecycle, named business owner, and demonstrable business value
 



 📌 Actively monitor Fabric capacity usage and implement practical controls to stay within allocated capacity
 



 📌 Ensure data pipelines are resilient, robust, and supported by effective alerting and monitoring
 



*Solution Design \& Delivery* 




 📌 Translate analytics and business requirements into clear technical requirements and delivery plans
 



 📌 Apply Fabric best practices and DataSecOps principles to design robust, scalable, maintainable solutions
 



 📌 Ensure relational data models, notebook code, SQL procedures, semantic models, and other artefacts are optimised and well designed
 



 📌 Lead the team to deliver well\-architected solutions, using AI responsibly under strong human judgement and accountability
 



*Cross\-Functional Collaboration* 




 📌 Collaborate with business and domain owners, the reporting team, and other IT teams to align priorities and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes
 



 ✅
 **Must\-Have Requirements** 



* 8–12\+ years in data engineering (or data engineering \+ software engineering) and BI, with demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end solution design
* Minimum 2 years hands\-on Microsoft Fabric delivery
* Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a data engineering team, including code/design review responsibility
* Track record operating within a fixed platform capacity budget (Fabric capacity SKUs, Databricks DBUs, Synapse pools, or equivalent), making trade\-off decisions to stay within it
* Experience defining or operating within a data governance framework — approval gates, ownership models, lifecycle/retention policy
* Prior experience working in an offshore/onshore delivery team



 ⭐
 **Good\-to\-Have** 



* Microsoft certifications relevant to Fabric/Power BI
* Prior experience in the Retail sector



 🔧
 **Technical Skills** 



* Fabric Lakehouse \& Warehouse design (Medallion Architecture)
* Fabric pipelines \& notebooks (SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark SQL)
* OneLake structure and Direct Lake mode into Power BI
* Power BI semantic model design and DAX
* Fabric capacity administration and workspace governance
* Git\-based version control and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub) for Fabric artefacts
* Security fundamentals: row\-level security, column\-level security, sensitivity labels, secrets management



 📍
 **Location** 




 Remote — anywhere in India.
 



 ⏰
 **Availability** 





 🔴
 
 Only Immediate Joiners should apply.
 
 🔴
 




 📩
 **How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates can DM or send their profile to garima.sharma@alkemiz.com.au

title: Master Data Lead
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Master Data Management Lead ( Sr Manager – IT )
   

  

**Reports To**
 VP\-IT / Global COE Head
   

  

 Purpose
   

  

 The Master Data Management Lead will be part of the Global Center of Excellence (COE) for CONMED, which will be operational from India.
   

  

 This role is crucial in building, governing, and operating enterprise master data capabilities across SAP S/4HANA and non\-SAP applications.
   

  

 The MDM Lead is responsible for leading both the technical and functional aspects of enterprise Master Data Management, including master
   

  

 data strategy, governance, standards, stewardship, data quality, workflow design, integration, migration readiness, and ongoing operations.
   

  

 The role will act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for master data across business teams, IT SAP COE, Business COE, data migration
   

  

 teams, analytics teams, and implementation partners.
   

  

 This position requires deep understanding of core master data domains such as Customer, Vendor/Supplier, Material/Product, Finance,
   

  

 Business Partner, BOM, Routing, Work Centers, and related organizational structures. The role will ensure that master data is accurate,
   

  

 governed, trusted, compliant, and aligned with business process requirements for SAP transformation, reporting, regulatory compliance, and
   

  

 operational excellence.
   

  

 As a member of the COE, the MDM Lead will define standards, governance processes, data quality controls, ownership models, and best
   

  

 practices. This role will also provide leadership for MDM platform design and execution, including Syniti, SAP MDG, SAP S/4HANA data
   

  

 governance, data migration, integration, and future\-state master data architecture.
   

  

 Key Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

 The Master Data Management Lead will be responsible for driving master data governance, functional alignment, technical solution design,
   

  

 data quality, and operational execution within the CONMED IT SAP COE. This role will ensure that enterprise master data supports end\-toend
   

  

 business processes, SAP S/4HANA implementation, regulatory expectations, analytics, and long\-term global business scalability.
   

  

* Develop and enhance enterprise MDM strategy: Define and execute the enterprise master data roadmap across Customer, Vendor/Supplier, Material/Product, Finance and other strategic data domains. Establish standards, policies, ownership models, and governance processes to improve consistency and quality across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Lead functional master data governance: Partner with business process owners and data owners to define business rules, data definitions, approval workflows, stewardship responsibilities, and exception management processes. Facilitate governance forums and drive alignment across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Commercial, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Define, design, and deliver MDM technical solutions: Lead design and implementation of MDM platforms and capabilities either Syniti, SAP MDG, or home grown application for MDG , SAP S/4HANA master data setup, data quality rules, workflow automation, validation controls, integration patterns, and data lifecycle management.
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformation and data migration: Own master data readiness for SAP deployment including profiling, cleansing, harmonization, mapping, migration rules, mock conversion support, data validation, cutover readiness, and post\-go live stabilization. Ensure future\-state master data design aligns with SAP business processes and enterprise architecture.
* Manage data quality, controls, and compliance: Define data quality scorecards, cleansing rules, duplicate prevention controls, mandatory field standards, audit trails, and governance metrics. Ensure master data processes support regulatory requirements, process controls, system validation, and audit readiness in a medical device environment.
* Provide technical and functional guidance: Guide SAP functional teams, data migration teams, integration teams, analytics teams, and business data stewards on master data standards, data models, dependencies, interfaces, and quality controls. Ensure common design principles are applied and duplication of effort is avoided.
* Drive integration and enterprise data alignment: Ensure master data is consistently integrated across SAP, legacy ERP applications, PLM, LIMS, CRM, planning systems, reporting platforms, and other relevant applications. Work with architecture and integration teams to establish scalable patterns for data synchronization and governance.
* Monitor MDM program progress and operational performance: Lead execution of MDM workstreams, track risks and issues, manage partner deliverables, monitor data readiness, and ensure high\-quality delivery across projects and operations. Establish regular reporting for leadership on data quality, remediation progress, and governance adoption.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders: Act as liaison between business teams, IT SAP COE, IT Business Partners , implementation partners, data stewards, and senior leaders. Translate technical data topics into business impact and ensure clear decision\-making on data ownership, standards, and remediation priorities.
* Continuous monitoring and improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify data processes, automate controls, improve stewardship productivity, reduce data defects, and enhance reporting confidence. Stay current with emerging MDM technologies, SAP MDG capabilities, Syniti functionality, AI\-enabled data quality, and industry best practices.
* Team building and mentorship: Build and mentor a high\-performing MDM team including data stewards, analysts, functional SMEs, and technical specialists. Provide coaching, standards, and repeatable methods to strengthen the enterprise data management capability.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Education \& Certification
   

  

* B Tech, Master’s Degree, MBA, or equivalent in Information Technology, Data Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, or related field.
* Advanced degree preferred.
* Certification in SAP, SAP MDG, Syniti, Data Governance, or equivalent preferred.


**Experience**
 Must have 12–15\+ years of overall experience in Data Management, ERP, SAP, Data Governance, Data Quality, or Enterprise Applications.
   

  

 Minimum of 7\+ years of experience leading enterprise Master Data Management programs in the capacity of MDM Lead, Data Governance
   

  

 Lead, SAP Data Lead, MDM Architect, or equivalent role.
   

  

**Key Skills**
* Strong working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA master data design and dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, Quality, and Planning processes.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation or major ERP transformation programs; at least 2–3 implementation / rollout / data migration cycles preferred.
* Hands\-on knowledge of master data domains including Business Partner, Customer, Vendor/Supplier, Material/Product, Finance master data, BOM, Routing, Work Centers, Plants, Storage Locations, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, GL Accounts, and related organizational structures.
* Experience with MDM / Data Governance platforms such as Syniti, SAP MDG, Informatica MDM, or any home grown application.
* Strong understanding of data governance operating models, data ownership, data stewardship, workflow approvals, data quality rules, metadata, and data lifecycle management.
* Experience in data profiling, cleansing, harmonization, enrichment, duplication management, migration mapping, validation, reconciliation, and cutover data readiness.
* Ability to define master data standards, naming conventions, mandatory fields, validation rules, governance controls, and exception management processes.
* Knowledge of integration between SAP and non\-SAP systems such as PLM, LIMS, CRM, planning systems, warehouse systems, analytics platforms, and legacy ERP applications.
* Experience working with SAP functional modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, EWM/WM, IBP, and integration touchpoints.
* Strong understanding of regulated industry expectations, including process controls, audit readiness, system validation, and data integrity requirements.
* Experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or other regulated global manufacturing industry strongly preferred.
* Experience in fast\-paced global multinational matrix organization.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage, influence, and align business stakeholders, SAP teams, data stewards, project teams, and implementation partners.
* Strong team player who collaborates well across business and IT to solve complex master data issues and actively incorporates input from various sources.
* Should have managed data governance forums, regulatory/audit discussions, partner teams, and senior stakeholder escalations.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Enterprise data strategy and governance leadership.
* Technical MDM architecture and platform delivery.
* Functional understanding of end\-to\-end SAP business processes.
* Data quality management, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership.
* Ability to lead both strategic design and hands\-on execution.


 Location
   

  

* Location is Remote in India.
* 30–40% Travel within India / Global as needed.

title: Associate Consultant, Workday Data Conversion
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We place great value on career growth, learning and collaboration. Employees are our \#1 value! We are an agile organization, constantly looking for ways to improve with a focus on the value we deliver to our customers. We work closely with people to acquire fast feedback and achieve the right outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A member of Workday’s Professional Services organization, the Associate Technical Consultant is passionate about the implementation of our cloud based Human Resources, Financial Management, and Student Information Systems. This role works closely with the customer’s project team to design, develop, and deploy solutions for one or more of the following focal areas: Data Conversion, Functional, Reporting, and Analytics.
   

  

 Workday is looking for a Consultant who has complete project lifecycle experience in a data conversion role. Experience with packaged HRMS/Financial systems is strongly desirable. The consultant directly connects with customer and project team specialists to design and execute highly strategic data conversion data loads for Workday implementations. This role provides consultancy on extraction and transformation and executes loading of legacy data via various integration products, tools, and services to ensure the successful deployment of our customers’ data into the Workday tenant.
   

  

**About You**
 About You
   

  

**Basic qualification**
* 3\+ years of data conversion technical experience for enterprise software applications
* Workday Experience preferred
* Hands on SQL skills
* Functional experience in HCM or Financials or Student modules
* Financial systems domain experience is preferred


**Other Qualification**
* Self\-motivated professional with strong follow\-through, who consistently keeps commitments to customers and fellow employees
* Can work in a fast paced, fast\-growth, high\-energy environment and execute multiple high priority activities concurrently
* Hands\-on experience with ETL software, Microsoft Excel
* Familiarity with web services and an appetite to learn more
* Passion for data accuracy and completeness
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills both technically and functionally
* Outstanding research skills and resourcefulness
* Strong planning, scheduling, and organization skills
* Collaborative teammate who can communicate effectively with all stakeholders


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
   

  

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:

 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
   

  

**Job Description**

 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading engineering teams, architecting scalable solutions, and delivering modern AI\-enabled applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and cloud\-native technologies.
   

  

 The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across the full software development lifecycle, mentor developers and AI engineers, collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive innovation through the adoption of AI and modern engineering practices.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Contract, Full-Time) [HR208]
description:
**About Smart Working** 



  


 At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity \- it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well\-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full\-time, long\-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
 


  


 Join one of the highest\-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote\-first world.
 


  


**About the Role** 



  


 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will build and lead the data infrastructure powering an intelligent AI assistant that automates operational workloads for property managers, letting agents and build\-to\-rent teams. The platform manages communications, compliance, maintenance coordination and scheduling, helping property businesses operate with the efficiency of modern digital platforms.
 


  


 You will architect and scale the systems behind the AI products, spanning real\-time data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, vector databases and machine learning data workflows. Working closely with AI engineers, backend engineers, product teams, founders and product leadership, you will ensure the platform can process large volumes of operational data reliably and intelligently.
 


  


 As the first senior data hire, you will define the data architecture, tooling, engineering standards, culture and hiring bar, building the foundations of the future data team.
 


  






  




**Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Architect and build scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support AI and product systems
  
* Design and maintain data ingestion, transformation and storage architectures for operational and AI workloads
  
* Develop and manage batch and real\-time data pipelines
  
* Build and optimise systems for vector search, retrieval and machine learning data pipelines
  
* Ensure data reliability, security and governance across the platform
  
* Collaborate with AI and backend engineering teams to support training, inference and product features
  
* Implement monitoring, observability and data quality frameworks
  
* Optimise the performance of large\-scale datasets and query systems
  
* Contribute to technical architecture decisions and long\-term data strategy
  
* Act as the founding data hire, defining culture, standards and the hiring bar for the data function as it scales
  
* Partner directly with founders and product leadership to translate data capabilities into product decisions
  

  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 7\+ years of professional experience, with the majority of that experience in dedicated data engineering roles
  
* Strong experience designing and building data pipelines and distributed data systems
  
* Experience working with relational databases, with PostgreSQL preferred, although MySQL or similar is acceptable
  
* Experience working with NoSQL databases
  
* Experience with vector databases used in modern AI systems
  
* Strong programming experience in Python
  
* Demonstrated ability to make and justify architectural decisions, rather than only implementing them
  
* Experience building scalable backend systems
  
* Experience designing data models and storage architectures
  
* Strong understanding of data processing performance and optimisation
  
* Experience with some of the following data frameworks and infrastructure technologies is highly desirable: Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafka, and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch
  
* Experience with relevant database technologies is highly desirable, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and vector databases such as Qdrant, Milvus or pgvector
  
* Experience with Python data\-processing libraries such as Pandas or Polars is highly desirable
  

  


  


  




**Nice to Have** 
  

  
* Experience working on AI or machine learning platforms
  
* Familiarity with stream processing and event\-driven architectures
  
* Experience with cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS or Azure
  
* Experience working in high\-growth startups or early\-stage companies
  

  


  





  




  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Revenue Operations (India Remote) - Hours 1-9pm IST
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
   

  

 You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket\-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
   

  

 This is an early\-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost\-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account\-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**What We're Looking For**
* A self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact\-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.


**Essential**
* 6 \- 8\+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands\-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production\-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands\-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git\-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
